note: This file is a pure MMDetection configuration file (dict-based). It contains no functions, classes, or callable code — only configuration data for the LAD (Label Assignment Distillation) object detection model with a ResNet-101 student and ResNet-50 teacher backbone on COCO.
summarize_LAD_config: summarize the LAD model config which defines a ResNet-101 student and ResNet-50 teacher for knowledge distillation on COCO detection
review_LADHead: review the LADHead config with FocalLoss, GIoULoss, and centerness loss for anchor-based detection
review_teacher_student_architecture: review the teacher-student architecture using PAA R50 teacher checkpoint and R101 student backbone
review_train_cfg: review the MaxIoUAssigner training config with pos/neg IoU threshold of 0.1
review_test_cfg: review the test config with NMS threshold 0.6, score threshold 0.05, and max 100 detections per image
